name: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card
benefit: Free hospital treatment up to 5 lakh rupees a year under PM-JAY, regardless of income.
how: Apply on the Ayushman app or at a nearby empanelled hospital with Aadhaar.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (NSAP)
benefit: Monthly pension from the centre plus state top-up.
how: Apply at the gram panchayat, municipal office or Umang app.

name: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
how: Open at any post office or bank.

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana
benefit: Free walking sticks, hearing aids, spectacles, wheelchairs.
how: Register at the district camp or social welfare office.

name: Elder Line 14567
benefit: Free national helpline for pension, legal, health and abuse help.
